acceptance: Stale stamps caught proactively (e.g. scheduled validation) so no contributor first meets this on an unrelated change
description: Twice on 2026-10-12 (revert of #2821, #2829) the audit record carried replay_sha values unreachable from develop (feature-branch commits). The check only runs when audit files change, so stale stamps accumulate undetected; each repair needed an honest prescribed-replay re-run.
